body: [CVPR 2024 Oral] InternVL Family: A Pioneering Open-Source Alternative to GPT-4o.  接近GPT-4o表现的开源多模态对话模型
plain_description: InternVL delivers commercial-grade multimodal AI as a free, open-source model family — matching GPT-4o and GPT-5 on vision, document, and reasoning benchmarks without vendor lock-in. You get image understanding, OCR, chart analysis, video comprehension, and multilingual support that you can run, fine-tune, and deploy on your own infrastructure. No per-token fees, no data sharing required.
technical_description: InternVL is an open-source multimodal large language model (MLLM) family from OpenGVLab, ranging from 1B to 241B parameters. The architecture pairs a vision encoder (InternViT, 300M-6B parameters) with a language backbone (Qwen2.5, InternLM, or Phi-3) via an MLP projector, supporting dynamic high-resolution image processing through variable visual position encoding (V2PE). Models are distributed in PyTorch via HuggingFace Transformers and support AWQ 4-bit quantization via lmdeploy. The codebase provides training, fine-tuning (full-parameter and LoRA), evaluation, and mixed preference optimization (MPO) pipelines. Inference runs locally on NVIDIA GPUs or through a hosted cloud API.
title: InternVL
